note: The script asks for the hook text, one name super, a location pin, one key-word line and two text cards, so 6 graphics and the end card. One text element is on screen at a time. The video is 16:9 and 9:16: use the size switch on this page.

mg.title: Hook text

text.main: She had to sell her cow

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1, top: “She had to sell her cow”. Already on screen at 0:00. It does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:04. Top band.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:05–00:08, small, lower left above the captions: “Vishal Ghotge” / CEO at Kiva.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:05 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <CEO at Kiva> under the name.

mg.title: Location pin
mg.cue: Location pin, upper left, at 00:16–00:19: “📍 Nairobi”.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:16 for 3 s, upper left, when he says Nairobi.

mg.title: Lump sum

text.main: lump sum at the beginning of the year

mg.cue: Key words, top, at 00:44–00:47: “lump sum at the beginning of the year”.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:44 when he says “lump sum”, for 3 s, top band. Captions stay on.

mg.title: Daughter 1 card
mg.cue: Text card at 00:52, 2.5 s, full frame on the Kiva dark green: “Daughter 1: sold the cow”.
mg.use: Cut to it at 00:52 for 2.5 s. His voice keeps running under it.

mg.title: Daughter 2 card
mg.cue: Text card at 01:00, 2.5 s, full frame on the Kiva dark green: “Daughter 2: kept the cow”.
mg.use: Cut to it at 01:00 for 2.5 s, then back to his face for “and not have to sell her cow”.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: “Give a little. Change a lot.” + kiva.org.
